shortDescription: Returns the content of a spooled file.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: job_name
options.description: A character string containing a qualified job name.

options.name: spooled_data_filter
options.description: If supplied, only return lines that match this shell-style (fnmatch) wildcard. If this parameter is omitted, all the spooled file content is returned.

options.name: spooled_file_name
options.description: A character string containing the name of the spooled file. If this parameter is an incorrect value or the spooled file is not existed, nothing will return to spooled_data.

options.name: spooled_file_number
options.description: A character string containing the number of the spooled file for current job. If this parameter is omitted, the spooled file with the highest number matching spooled-file-name is used.
